protocol: three outer subject folds with a separate inner holdout

dataset.measurement: ECG-derived HR aggregated in sequential five-minute source windows
limitations: Only non-stress visits are long enough for the default one-hour target
No raw ECG, signal-quality labels, device-specific validation or clinical outcomes
Cortisol, HRV and stress labels are not model inputs

paired_subject_bootstrap.definition: selected_policy MAE minus base MAE; negative favours selected policy
paired_subject_bootstrap.limitation: Conditional on fitted folds; models are not retrained within bootstrap

interpretation: Assessment of a selection procedure, not a single deployable checkpoint or external clinical validation
